summary: Titan International filed an 8-K disclosing that subsidiaries Titan ITM Holding S.p.A. and Titan Europe Limited agreed on September 21, 2026 to sell all equity of Italtractor ITM S.p.A. to Italy's USCO S.p.A. for about $207 million cash plus up to roughly $6 million earnout tied to 2026 performance criteria. The price adjusts for working capital, transaction expenses, cash and debt at closing. ITM spans Germany, China, Delaware, Brazil, Spain, Australia and India. Closing conditions include representation accuracy and material performance; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch regulatory clearances and earnout risk.
